item_name: Wandering—Impact: Does the wandering significantly intrude on the privacy or activities of others?

lookback_source.quote: Consider the previous review of the resident's wandering behaviors identified in E0900 for the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The item's own Steps for Assessment state a 7-day look-back period, consistent with the E0900 wandering frequency window. Counted per the general convention as the ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-17: "ARD + 6 previous calendar days"). No other windows are stated for this item.

coding_levels.label: No
coding_levels.definition: Code 0, no: if the wandering does not intrude on the privacy or activity of others.

source.quote: Code 0, no: if the wandering does not intrude on the privacy or activity of others.

coding_levels.label: Yes
coding_levels.definition: Code 1, yes: if the wandering intrudes on the privacy or activities of others (i.e., if the wandering violates other residents' privacy or interrupts other residents' performance of activities of daily living or limits engagement in or enjoyment of social or recreational activities), whether or not the other resident complains or communicates displeasure or annoyance.

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if the wandering intrudes on the privacy or activities of others (i.e., if the wandering violates other residents' privacy or interrupts other residents' performance of activities of daily living or limits engagement in or enjoyment of social or recreational activities), whether or not the other resident complains or communicates displeasure or annoyance.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Complete E1000 (including E1000B) only if E0900, Wandering—Presence & Frequency, was coded 1, 2, or 3.

source.quote: Answer this item only if E0900, Wandering—Presence & Frequency, was coded 1 (behavior of this type occurred 1-3 days), 2 (behavior of this type occurred 4-6 days, but less than daily), or 3 (behavior of this type occurred daily).

federal_coding_rules.rule: If E0900 is coded 0 (behavior not exhibited), skip to E1100, Change in Behavior or Other Symptoms (E1000 is not completed).

source.quote: Code 0, behavior not exhibited: if wandering was not exhibited during the 7-day look-back period. Skip to Change in Behavior or Other Symptoms item (E1100).

federal_coding_rules.rule: Determine whether the wandering behaviors significantly intrude on the privacy or activities of others based on clinical judgment for the individual resident.

source.quote: Determine whether those behaviors put the resident at significant risk of getting into potentially dangerous places and/or whether wandering significantly intrudes on the privacy or activities of others based on clinical judgment for the individual resident.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code 1, yes even if the other resident does not complain or communicate displeasure or annoyance.

source.quote: whether or not the other resident complains or communicates displeasure or annoyance

federal_coding_rules.rule: Moving about by propelling oneself in a wheelchair meets the definition of wandering; intruding into another resident's room and interfering with that resident's ability to use the bathroom is coded E1000B = 1, yes.

source.quote: Coding: E1000B would be coded 1, yes. Rationale: Moving about in this manner with the use of a wheelchair meets the definition of wandering, and the resident has intruded on the privacy of another resident and has interfered with that resident's ability to use the bathroom.

federal.criterion: Consider the previous review of the resident's wandering behaviors identified in E0900 for the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Consider the previous review of the resident's wandering behaviors identified in E0900 for the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Stated as a required assessment step for E1000.

federal.criterion: Medical record review and staff interview establishing that wandering occurred during the 7-day look-back period (the E0900 determination that gates completion of E1000B).

source.quote: Review the medical record and interview staff to determine whether wandering occurred during the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Stated under E0900, the item that determines whether E1000B is completed.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages do not tie E1000B to any payment or case-mix classification.
